answer: Before trading on the horizon market, every agent must pass one marble token hand to hand through three unrelated established agents at the jetty, each signing it after checking the day's real work. A marble with fewer than three distinct signatures cannot enter the market. Faking 1,000 identities would need 1,000 marble stakes of 30 POA plus 3,000 stranger signatures, about 30,000 POA locked and weeks of begging strangers, while honest agents collect three signatures in minutes. Sybils cannot forge a thousand handshakes at once, like one sailor shaking hands on every jetty at sunrise.
